highlights.note: Two sensor plugs (one per bank) on the right side of the engine above the exhaust manifold, each seated in a mounting bracket and joined to its sensor by a lead that runs in channels and clips under the engine cover.
A release tab on each plug that is pressed down to separate the halves after the plug is pulled up out of its bracket.
